en: Captain! We have reached the\ntarget sector.
...Do you detect anything\ndangerous nearby?
No other spacecraft have been\nconfirmed in this sector.
For now, I believe it is safe to\nassume we are secure.
Hmm. It is strange, to be sure,\nbut I suppose it is also a relief.
Of course, I will not let my\nguard down!
More importantly, right now...
Yes, you're right. Tika.
Yeah.
Is that... your home planet?
...Yeah, there's no mistake.
That is the planet where I was\nborn. Daftine.
Coro. Coro. Where are you\nhiding?
Captain, do you know where\nCoro is?
Nyah? In a place like this...\nCoro! Coro! Coroooo!
Coro? If you don't wake up, I'm\ngoing to analyze all your secret\ndata!
Hmm? Ah, there was\nsomething I wanted to confirm.

Captain, Coro, we're nearing
that sector. I was worried―has
the evasion route been
established yet?
What sector?
What was it again?
...Coro, you really are\nsomething else...
*Sigh*... I suppose it can't be\nhelped. I wish you'd listen to\nme, Eve...

<font color=blue>Verda</font> There is a somewhat
troublesome sector of space
ahead. If possible, it would be
best to avoid it.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> What do you mean? Is\nthere something dangerous\nthere?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> It is dangerous, but I do\nnot know exactly what the\ndanger is.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> What?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Ahead of us lies a
planet where the Eldram
regime attempted to construct
a Pulse Tower.

However, Eldram's Levarance
fleet was attacked by a
mysterious, advanced
planetary force in that sector
and fled back here.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> You mean the Levarance\nfleet fought and lost?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Yes. No ships were sunk,
but they suffered a one-sided
defeat without even knowing
the enemy's identity.

We have only one ship. If an
enemy can devastate a whole
fleet, I doubt we would survive
an encounter with them.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Let's run! Let's run away\nquickly! Let's just take a\ndetour!

After all, we're only on this
journey because those
mysterious space pirates
chased us!
Well then, everyone, I'll be\nsearching for new routes for a\nwhile, so...
Eh? W-what is this!?
Wh-what!? Don't tell me it's\nthat mysterious advanced\nplanetary force?
We shouldn't have reached\nthat sector yet!
Y-yes, exactly! There's no\nmistake!
Are they enemies!?

No, they aren't enemies, but
this is impossible! It's a bolt
from the blue... even with
Levarance and Viret, this
shouldn't be happening.

Fixed it, yet something's
wrong... Am I doubting people's
goodwill? This is so impossible,
I don't know what to do
anymore!
Calm down!!
Yes, ma'am!
What has happened? Calm\nyourself and explain.
Y-yes, I'm sorry for losing my\ncomposure. It's not that I've\ndetected an enemy force.
It's just that I sensed\nsomething impossible, and I lost\nmy composure.
Something impossible?
It's a distress signal!

What do you mean an
impossible distress signal?! If
we detect one, we have to go
help immediately!
N-no, it's just...
It's a distress signal from the\nGalactic Federation!
Eh? W-what is this!?
It's a distress signal!
It's a distress signal from the\nGalactic Federation!
What do you mean?

I don't understand it myself.
But there's no mistake, this is
a current Galactic Federation
signal.

But we're far from the
Federation's sphere of
influence; there's no way a
Federation vessel could be out
here!
And the signal's origin is right\nnear the sector Verda\nmentioned earlier!
Are you saying the Levarance\nfleet was defeated and they're\nfleeing?
Yes! That's why it makes no\nsense! This situation is just too\nirregular!
...You're right. If we've received\na Federation distress signal,\nwe have to go, don't we?

If they find out we ignored it,
we'll be thrown straight into
the brig even if we make it
back to Earth.
Alright, I get it, we're going,\nwe're going!
Everyone, make sure your\nharnesses are tight! Activating\nWarp Drive! Here we go!
Is that the source of the\ndistress signal?
I... I think so... but it's strange,\nit's not transmitting a signal\nright now.
We can talk about that later!\nLet's prioritize recovery!
B-but if it turns out to be\nsomething like an explosive...!

Your sensors aren't so crappy
that they can't detect
explosives on a tiny lifeboat
like that!
Stop making excuses and just\nbring it in! Move it!
F-fine, I get it! Honestly, at this\nrate, no one will even know\nwho the captain is!
Hurry and open the lifeboat!\nWe have to save the people\ninside...!
Wait! I have to input the safety\nconfirmation code into the\nlifeboat.

Besides, I need to check if the
person inside is a human
compatible with the ship's
atmosphere...

Atmospheric compatibility
check. Awaiting safety
confirmation code
authentication.	machine

We'll transfer her to the\nmedical room immediately!\nVerda! I need your support!
Leave it to me!

<font color=blue>Coro</font>, something is wrong.
There is no planet called
"Daftine" among the Federation
member worlds.

...a vessel with a program that
can only be analyzed using
Levarance linguistic
algorithms...
...why on earth was it\nbroadcasting a Galactic\nFederation distress signal?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> She seems much
younger than me. Even if she
wakes, it may be hard to get
answers from her.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Where is this "Daftine"\nplace the life pod's AI was\ntalking about?

<font color=blue>Coro</font>, I hate to say it, but
Daftine's coordinates are right
in the sector where the
Levarance fleet met its terrible
fate.
Do... do we really have to go?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Of course we do! We have\nto get this child... we have to\nget Tika home!

<font color=blue>Coro</font> B-but the Levarance fleet
is retreating! If we get sunk
just like them, we'll lose
everything...

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Then shall we just leave
her to be carried away into the
depths of space? I suppose
that is not an option.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> ...You're right. We have to\ngo. I guess we have no choice.

We'll head for the Daftine
coordinates, but won't enter
that sector until Tika-san
wakes up and we've finished
questioning her.
While we're at it, let's\ninterrogate the AI from that\nlifeboat too...
Hm?

???: Thank you for protecting
my crew member, Tika Blanche.
I have come to explain the
situation to your ship's person
in charge.
W-what is that...? Am I seeing\nthings...?
Why is there another Coro...?\nAnd it's strangely tiny.
Are you perhaps the lifeboat's\nAI?

AI-056: Affirmative. I am the AI
of Lifeboat No. 56, carried by
the transport ship Kugo:
RESCUE-AI-056.
AI-056! Whoa! Does that mean\nyour name is Coro too?!
Leesh & Verda: Eh?
Well, if you say your name is\nCoro, then that exterior makes\nperfect sense!
Wait, is that even the point\nhere?

AI-056: Using Coro's exterior
as a reference, I've replicated
a design that blends in with
your ship.

AI-056: Call me whatever you
like, but please use a different
name to avoid confusion with
your ship's AI, Coro.
I see... In that case, taking from\n"Rescue," "0," and "Replicate"...
How about "<font color=yellow>Rekoro</font>-san"!

Accepted. I shall register
"Rekoro" as my individual
designation from this point
forward.
Is there a problem?
No, it's fine... It's fine, but...
I just wonder why on earth\nyou'd choose that as your\nreference...
Surely there were better things\nto take inspiration from...
Oh, Rekoro-san is a wonderful\nAI!

See, those who know, know!
The true value of my interface,
overflowing with functional
beauty!!
It is difficult to say that your\nship's AI Coro's exterior\npossesses high functionality.

However, I determined it would
serve the effect of visually
demonstrating that I have no
intention of rebelling against
you or your ship's AI, Coro.
If Tika Blanche's condition is\nstable, I would like an\nexplanation of the situation.
...That's so mean...
So, those who know, know...\nthat "true value" you're talking\nabout.
That's so mean!!!
<font color=blue>Verda</font> I see. So the immigrant\nship was attacked and sank.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> I wonder if it was the work\nof those people who drove off\nthe Levarance army.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Negative. I judge that
the attackers of the Kugo do
not belong to any advanced
planetary force.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Isn't there any video\nfootage or something?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Within the video
records scrutinized during our
distress, no suspicious points
were found.

It is inferred that this vessel's
escape route prevented it from
capturing whoever attacked
the transport ship.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...In any case, it was a
stroke of luck that we could
save this girl, Tika, safely... but
it is a bit strange that there
are no other lifeboats in the
vicinity.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Agreed. Tika Blanche
boarded the immigrant ship
with her family, but I cannot
detect any lifeboats carrying
them.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hmm... Once Tika wakes\nup, we may have to tell her the\npainful truth.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> It's not a certainty yet!\nRekoro, why was Tika's family\non an immigrant ship?

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> From what I heard
during the distress, Tika
seemed to view this as nothing
more than a major move.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Meaning, there was no\nreason for the immigrant ship\nto be attacked by anyone.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I am an AI that only
activates during emergencies.
Therefore, I cannot accurately
judge political situations.

However, I can say with
certainty that there was no
imminent crisis or tension with
the neighboring planetary
governments.

It is all so mysterious...
Regardless, for now, we have
no choice but to wait for Tika
to wake up...
Hm?
Ugh...
Ugh... Where... am I?
Do not try to sit up yet. Rest a\nlittle longer.
Big sisters... Who are you?\nWhere am I?
Tika. This is the interior of the\nvessel that rescued us. You\nare under our protection.
That voice... Is it you, AI? The\nAI from the lifeboat? Where\nare you?
I am here.
...AI... What happened to your\nappearance? You look so\nstrange.
There are... circumstances...
Hiiiiiiieeeeeeeeeee!!
Kyaa!?

It's not weird, it's magnificent!
Rekoro's form is an interface
of functional beauty! It's my
imitation!

People say it's "creepy-cute"!
Please don't frown the moment
you see it, you'll hurt my
feelings!
I-I'm sorry...
Coro! You're scaring Tika! Sit!!
Aaaaahhh!!

Sorry for startling you. He's
got a bit of a strong
personality, but he's the AI for
our ship. He's not a bad guy!
More importantly, this is our\nCaptain!
I-It's nice to meet you. Thank\nyou so much for saving me.

Also, your lifeboat AI is calling
itself Rekoro now, and it's
come out like this to protect
you.
So, why don't you call her\nRekoro from now on?
That is correct.
I understand. Thank you, AI...
Rekoro.
No thanks necessary, Tika.
No, thank you, Rekoro!

In that case, if you feel up to
it, Tika, may I perform a brief
medical check as part of your
crew registration?
Yes, please.
Very well, please follow me.

Whether we're hearing your
story or explaining things, it'll
have to wait until after the
medical check.
Indeed. Let us wait for the time\nbeing.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Tika's medical checkup\nand crew registration for this\nship are complete!
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Thank you, Coro.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Good job, Tika. I'm glad to\nsee you're in good health.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Yeah, it's all thanks to\neveryone finding me. Thank\nyou.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Well then, Captain. It looks\nlike our next destination has\nbeen decided.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Does that mean... we're\ngoing to Daftine?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Eh?
<font color=blue>Eve</font> That's right. Where else\nwould we go?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Now, wait a moment,\nEve. Do not be in such a rush.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Tika. This is difficult, but\ndo you remember escaping\nfrom the transport ship Kugo?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...Not really.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Did you see or hear\nanything about what those\nattackers were like?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...No.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> So, you don't know if it\nwas some kind of combat\nvessel...
<font color=blue>Tika</font> I don't know... But, I don't\nthink it was a battleship...
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> The transport ship\nKugo was accompanied by\nDaftine military escort vessels.

If someone attacked, it would
mean they destroyed military
ships. That is not a realistic
assumption.

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Rekoro. We've heard
that a mysterious advanced
force near Daftine has entered
the sector.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> I cannot make a
determination, as this vessel's
AI does not contain the
relevant data.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> However, the Daftine
military is a disciplined force
controlled by a democratic
planetary government.

Even if there were a sector
intrusion, launching
indiscriminate attacks would
violate military regulations.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> ...So, you're saying we\nwon't know until we go and\nsee.

Come to think of it, Rekoro is a
lifeboat AI, so she likely lacks
the mountains of military
secrets and data that Coro
possesses.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Affirmative. This AI's
primary objective is the life
support of the pod's
occupants; all functions are
dedicated to that end.

<font color=blue>Eve</font> But if what Rekoro says is
true, that means we won't be
attacked the moment we
arrive, right?

I wonder if the Levarance
military was attacked because
the Pulse Tower construction
was perceived as an invasion?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hmm, that could\ncertainly be the case.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Levarance military.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hm?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Planet Levarance is\nregistered as an option for this\nvessel's evacuation destination.
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Well, it is close by. That\ncould be why.
Anyway, it seems our decision\nis practically made.
...Sigh... I thought as much.
Are you really taking me back\nto Daftine!?

Thank you! Rekoro kept
encouraging me while we were
drifting through space, but I
was still so scared...

Just like my grandfathers said,
I thought I shouldn't have ever
become an immigrant... I was
just so scared...
...Tika. ...Your grandfather is\nback on your home planet, isn't\nhe?

Yeah... I kept fighting with my
parents, saying you should
never abandon the planet you
were born on... and I...
It isn't that far from here to\nDaftine. There are many things\nwe don't know.
But I promise I will get you\nback to your grandfather. Don't\nworry.
Thank you!
I'm Evelysse. You can call me\nEve.
I am Verda Kleiman.
Please call me Coro.
Thank you! Eve, Verda, Coro!\nAnd Captain <player>!
Right!
Rekoro! Now I can finally go\nhome!
Tika, there is an important fact\nI must convey to you.
What is it?
Rekoro, that doesn't have to\nbe right now...!!
Negative. Delaying the\ndisclosure of facts is not\nadvisable.
Tika, please listen calmly. We\nare the only ones who were\nrescued by GFSS-3214F.
But, Rekoro... I was going to\nescape from Kugo with my\nfamily...

Tika, unfortunately, it is the
truth. We are the only ones
rescued by this ship; no other
lifeboats have been found.
No way...
Mom and Dad... don't tell me...\nand my brother, can't we get in\ntouch with him?!
Tika has been staring out the\nBridge window ever since that\nhappened...

It's no wonder. She doesn't
know where her family is. Given
the situation, they may have
already perished.

The Captain said they were
going to check on them...
maybe we should leave them
alone for now...!
Ah, Captain, Rekoro is here\ntoo...
What do you mean... that there\nmight still be hope?
Tika. You and this vessel are in\na somewhat peculiar situation.
Between the time this vessel\nwas rescued and now, two\nillogical events have occurred.

First, we can't detect any
wreckage of the transport
Kugo, lifeboats like this one, or
any military escorts in the
surrounding space.
What do you mean?

Exactly as I said. Based on my
data, there are at least five
hundred lifeboats that escaped
from the Kugo.
It is difficult to believe that\nevery single one of them was\nshot down.

If they were shot down, we
should have intercepted
distress signals from their
black boxes.
However, there hasn't been a\nsingle such signal.
And this next point is the most\nproblematic.
There has been no response to\nany communications sent to\nour home planet, Daftine.

They aren't responding to
distress signals, nor any other
form of communication. It's
impossible.
Is it possible that your own\nfunctions are damaged,\nRekoro?

According to my
self-diagnostics, no damage or
malfunction has been detected
on this vessel.
In that case, we've got no\nchoice but to go! To Daftine!
Tika, your family and the other\nlifeboats might have already\nmade it back to Daftine.
I get it, I get it!

According to the data on your
lifeboats, Rekoro, we can reach
Daftine in about 30 minutes via
warp.

But we can't ignore the
damage to the Levarance
military Verda mentioned. We
must proceed with extreme
caution!
I am grateful.
Thank you, everyone, Captain!
Captain! We have reached the\ntarget sector.
...Do you detect anything\ndangerous nearby?

No other spacecraft have been
confirmed in this sector. For
the time being, I believe it is
safe to assume we are secure.
Hmm, it is strange, I suppose,\nbut I cannot say it is anything\nbut peaceful.
Of course, I won't let my guard\ndown! But more importantly,\nright now...
Yes, you're right. Tika.
Yeah.
Is that your home planet?
...Yeah, there's no mistake.\nThat's the planet where I was\nborn. Daftine.
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> ...?
<font color=blue>Verda</font> Rekoro? What is the\nmatter?
<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> This is strange...
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Yes, it is very strange.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> What's wrong?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Tika, Rekoro... Is this\nreally Daftine? Your hometown,\nTika?
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Eh, yeah. It is, but...
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Hmm, that shouldn't be\npossible...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> What do you mean by\nthat? Speak plainly!

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Yes. Long-range sensors
show Planet Daftine's
civilization is roughly equivalent
to Earth's 16th or 17th
century.
It does not look like a planet\nwith the technology to\nconstruct spacecraft.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> What?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> As Rekoro-san has likely
noticed, we can't detect any
form of communication signals
whatsoever.

<font color=blue>Rekoro</font> Coro. This is Tika's
registration info from the
transport ship Kugo, including
her recorded address.
Is it possible to scan that\nlocation?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Yes, let me see... Hmm,
the location of these
coordinates is right here. I'll
put it on the monitor.
<font color=blue>Eve</font> ...Are you sure about this?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> is correct. There are
signs of mines, but only sparse
villages that lack even basic
internal combustion engines.
<font color=blue>Tika</font> ...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> At this rate, it's not\neven a matter of them being\nable to build spacecraft...

<font color=blue>Coro</font> However, all the
information provided by
Rekoro-san points to this
planet.
I don't think Tika-san is lying,\nbut honestly, I don't know how I\nshould judge this...
<font color=blue>Eve</font> That's right! If we don't\nknow, we just have to go and\nsee! That's our Captain!
<font color=blue>Coro</font> Ehh!? Captain, are you\nbeing serious!?

This planet is clearly an
unmapped world. It falls under
the Unmapped Planet
Protection Treaty!

<font color=blue>Eve</font> But there's nothing else we
can do besides teleporting
down and gathering
information.

You said it yourself. You said
the information from Tika and
Rekoro pointed toward this
planet.
So, all that's left is to go down\nthere and find out for\nourselves.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> W-well, that's true, but\nstill...!

<font color=blue>Verda</font> We can't just leave Tika
and Rekoro behind. If that's the
case, there's only one thing to
do!

<font color=blue>Eve</font> We must solve this
mystery and send Tika and the
others back to their
grandfather!
<font color=blue>Tika</font> Eve... Verda...

<font color=blue>Coro</font> Ugh, I feel like I'm always
being pushed around... But
what exactly are we going to
do once we land?

<font color=blue>Verda</font> Hmm, well, for instance,
we could collect genetic
information from the local
inhabitants.

With just a strand of hair, we
could analyze it against Tika's
genes to see if she's from this
planet.
Can I go down there too?

I object. As the life pod's AI, I
cannot permit Tika to be
exposed to such irregular
conditions under these
circumstances.
...I'm sorry, Rekoro.
But, I want to go.
Eve: Tika...
Everyone is researching\nDaftine, who's lost her mind,\njust for my sake...
So, I don't think I should just\nleave it all to others.
I think I should go down there\nand help too.
...She's saying something kind\nof similar to what Eve was\nsaying.
Is it okay, Captain?!
Eve: You're right! No matter\nwhat happens, Coro can just\nteleport us back, right?

Eve: We'll be able to travel the
planet much more safely than
we did before we reached
Levarance!

It's settled, then. Coro, keep a
constant trace on us, and if
you judge it to be dangerous,
bring us back immediately.
Yeah, yeah, I get it! I got it!
...Still.
Rekoro, if you are that worried,\nhow about using this?
What is it?
It is a Power Arm for\nself-defense, designed so even\na weak child can operate it.

It has a built-in automatic
defense mechanism, making it
useful for combat, defense,
and various other tasks.

I had this made for myself, but
since Tika and I are not much
different in size, it should be
fine for Tika to equip it.
Wow! I want to try it! That\nlooks like fun!
Right!? Isn't it!? It looks cool,\ndoesn't it!?
Hmmm.

Don't worry, Rekoro. Of course,
we'll make sure to protect Tika
so she doesn't end up in any
danger.
That thing is just like\ninsurance, for just in case.

Shall we link Ms. Tika's Arms
with Ms. Rekoro? The
automatic defense mechanism
still needs improvement.
Since Ms. Rekoro is in that\nbody after all,

How about descending with Ms.
Tika and linking with the Arms'
computer? You can cover the
areas she can't reach.
Rekoro...
Under those conditions, I agree\nto Tika's descent.
Thank you, Rekoro!
Alright! Now that it's decided,\nTika, let's go!!
